Read the [contribution requirements](https://github.com/stefan-jansen/zipline-reloaded/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.rst) and search existing
issues before opening one issue for one problem. Zipline Reloaded accepts bug,
security and compatibility fixes and improvements to existing documentation;
direct new feature requests to current ML4T libraries.

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately to pm@ml4trading.io.

Discuss substantial changes here before implementing them. For numerical changes,
describe the expected definition, annualization, sign convention or default and
any compatibility impact; existing output alone does not establish correctness.
